items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: General Morton was more known than Johnny Dodds.

ctx.x: And, uh... Do you like Johnny Dodds? Oh, very much. Well, what do most people in France, both of the jazz fans, think of Johnny Dodds?

Oh, he is very few known. In fact, the French people know the big names, that's to say Armstrong, obviously, Bichet, because he is here in France. But they know King Oliver very few, and Johnny Dodds, I don't think, but there are only some fans, some specialists who they know. And we have a lot of trouble finding Johnny Dodds in France. We know General Morton. General Morton was more known than Johnny Dodds. Maybe because the piano is a more commercial instrument than the clarinet, or more easy.
Well, what do you think about the New Orleans musicians who have come there in person? Have you heard Bonnie Bigard, Albert Nicholas, any of those? Yes.
